mode.title: Scrape Mode
mode.description: What to capture. "Product + Seller (full)": full product details plus the seller profile, store reviews and product previews. "Product only": product details + reviews only, no seller enrichment. "Seller only": provide STORE URLs in Start URLs — an independent browser pipeline opens each store page directly on the real local IP (no proxy, no fingerprint) and solves any captcha via 2captcha.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: URLs to scrape. For the "Product" modes these are product detail pages (https://www.aliexpress.com/item/<id>.html). For "Seller only" mode these are store pages (https://www.aliexpress.com/store/<id>).

headless.title: Headless Browser
headless.description: Run Chrome in headless (new) mode. Disable to run headful via Xvfb, which is harder to detect but uses more resources.

twoCaptchaApiKey.title: 2captcha API Key
twoCaptchaApiKey.description: API key for 2captcha (https://2captcha.com). Used by "Seller only" mode to solve reCAPTCHA punish pages. Falls back to the TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY environment variable if left empty.
